sections.narrative:
You stand before the dark entrance to Firetop Mountain. A chill wind blows from within. Torchlight flickers on damp stone walls. Somewhere deep inside, the Warlock awaits.

Two passages lead forward.
The left passage opens into a small chamber. A goblin guard spins around, reaching for his blade!

choices.text: Search the body and take the iron key

sections.narrative: The right passage leads to a locked iron door. There is no way through without a key.
You find a heavy iron key on the goblin's belt and take it. The right passage now beckons.

choices.text: Try the iron key on the locked door

sections.narrative: The key turns. The iron door swings open with a groan. Beyond lies a grand hall — and at its far end, the Warlock of Firetop Mountain rises from his throne.
The Warlock falls. His treasure vaults are yours. You have conquered Firetop Mountain!
